title: Add current LDBC and memtier noise to production gate profile
description: BENCHPROD-064 production medium repeat passed all suite thresholds and had 0 case errors, but default gate failed because several low-latency unstable cases were outside the versioned allowlist.

evidence.reason: sub-millisecond or low-millisecond CV/spread noise; suite-level thresholds and error checks passed

summary: Added `ldbc:Recent posts by friends`, `memtier:GET by key`, and `memtier:SET existing key` to the production_medium unstable case allowlist.
Kept suite thresholds, max unstable suites, and max unstable cases unchanged.
